statement.excerpt: Those who don’t have burned $100M on driverless cars and are in process of burning similar amounts of money on GenAI.
statement.document_title: This one important fact about current AI explains almost everything

from_speaker: are in process of burning similar amounts of money on GenAI
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that people who misunderstand outlier limitations have already lost or wasted roughly $100 million on autonomous driving and are spending comparable sums on generative AI.

The driverless-car statement is cumulative through the post, with no stated starting date. For the ongoing generative-AI statement, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication is April–June 2024.
The combined target period ends at publication and has an unspecified start because the sentence combines cumulative expenditure with an ongoing state.
Investment, expenditure, cash burn and accounting losses are distinct measures. The word 'burned' does not identify which measure Marcus intended.
The stated amount remains $100 million. It is not silently changed to $100 billion.
criteria.support_condition: Records identify the relevant people or businesses independently of their losses, establish their misunderstanding of outliers, and document roughly $100 million of driverless-car losses or wasted expenditure plus comparable ongoing generative-AI expenditure on a consistent basis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records for the identified group establish materially different amounts, or show that the attribution to misunderstanding outliers is false.
